testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/pdp/verify-brand-hyperlink-navigation-on-pdp.spec.ts > Webstore - PDP > verify brand hyperlink navigation on pdp

scenario.summary: Guest opens a product PDP by SKU, checks the breadcrumb (category path and name) and the 'Brand:<brand>' label, clicks the brand hyperlink and checks the brand listing page heading, breadcrumb 'Home / Shop By Brand / <brand>' and results. Read-only.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search the product SKU, assert 'Showing 1 of 1 Results', open the result and check the product image.
Assert breadcrumb Home/<category path>/<product name> and the label Brand:<brand>.
Click the brand hyperlink and wait for the brand listing page.
Assert the brand page heading, its breadcrumb and that results are shown.
assertions: Search shows 'Showing 1 of 1 Results' and the product image is visible.
Breadcrumb equals Home/<category path>/<product name>; brand label equals Brand:<brand>.
Brand page heading equals the brand; breadcrumb equals 'Home / Shop By Brand / <brand>'; results text contains 'Showing'.
evidence: Title 'verify brand hyperlink navigation on pdp' and step labels 1) and 2) match the flow.
Profile: z-1234579 FOUND as active BundleProduct, brand Dewalt, PRODUCTION; brand Dewalt FOUND active (code Dewalt) with 58 products.

The test needs any product whose brand is set, plus that brand; PRODUCT_SIMPLE_OF_BRAND_IN_STOCK (linked to the brand need by @brand.code) fits better than a bundle key, which cannot tie the product to the brand. The recorded product is a bundle, so it is not set as preferred and the resolver will pick a simple Dewalt product.
GAP: the breadcrumb asserts the product's category path (productCategory 'Tools / Power Tools'); no key returns a product's category path, so that value has no output to come from.
brandBreadcrumb is derived from the brand ('Home / Shop By Brand / ' + brand).
migrate: productCategory maps to no key output and brandBreadcrumb is derived from the brand data.
No data value appears in the spec code; the spec reads the JSON through loadData.
